misconception_description: Student believes that colons (:) are used for variable assignment.

solutions.generated_code:
program JumlahHarmonik
kamus
  n, i : integer
  jumlah : real
algoritma
  input(n)
  jumlah : 0
  for i <- 1 to n do
    jumlah : jumlah + 1 / i
  endfor
  output(jumlah)
endprogram

metadata.modification_notes: The student rewrote the solution to store the intermediate result in a variable before returning it. Due to their misconception that colons are used for variable assignment, they wrote 'result : 1 / n + harmonic_sum(n - 1)' instead of 'result = 1 / n + harmonic_sum(n - 1)'. This results in a SyntaxError. The student believes this is the correct way to assign values to variables and expects the code to work perfectly. They may have confused the assignment operator with type annotation syntax (which uses colons) or simply learned the wrong syntax for assignment.
